metadata.title: The a0 Law with Cold Dark Energy Counted Once: the Form the Record Closes On, Its Gates, and What Stays Open (Working Note)
metadata.description:
Working note, version 1.0 (2026-11-09). AI-assisted research programme; not peer reviewed; not reproduced by any outside group. kappa = 1/2 is fitted; the theory is not closed; nothing here says the data favour this framework.

This note states the form on which the record closes and grades it. It does not complete the theory. The a0 law alone fails the CMB, the growth of structure, clusters and the Bullet, each for want of the same cold, clustering component of about 5.4 times the baryons. Every way tried of keeping that component out of galaxies has a failing verdict; the last one is recorded here. The form chosen by the owner on 2026-11-09 counts the component once: it is in galaxies too, and around condensed baryons the law describes how it sits. It is real mass, not a second force. In the adopted action this is the static state's own reading: the law's halo is the khronon sector's energy density, carried by the one conserved charge that is dust in the expanding background. We regrade the form with criteria frozen before any number. On groups and clusters it is not falsified, by a gate that can fail from one side only, and the richest clusters sit at its ceiling; the Bullet passes only if the subcluster's stripped gas is counted. On hosted dwarfs it fails: it removes most of the law's shortfall in every class, but two classes stay high and four low rows cannot be reached. On KiDS lensing by galaxy type the test returns no verdict; its readings put early types between the law and the form's truncated halo and cannot place discs; on host-free lenses the form passes a gate that does not separate it from the law. The form passes rotation curves. Its CMB, lensing and growth rows hold when computed, on an amended reading of that lane's checks. With the amplitude of fluctuations pinned by large-angle polarisation, CMB lensing matches the prediction to 0.3 sigma and the growth rate passes. Raw KiDS weak lensing, on a gravity-only spectrum, prefers an amplitude five of its own widths lower: the absolute fit is excluded at 3 sigma by the frozen line and reads tension once the reference run's realisation noise is corrected, a check made after grading. This is the tension that any cold component fitted to the CMB carries; the form states neither gas ejection nor neutrino mass, and does not relieve it. No solution has been computed that takes infalling dust to the static state. With gravity coupled that state is linearly stable around a point mass; an instability found earlier belonged to a planar background, and flattened baryons have not been analysed. No single dust term serves the CMB and galaxies, and no cluster state has been solved. We list what is open, the measurement that would decide each item, and our own wrong estimates.

The supplement zip holds every committed file of the lanes the note cites (criteria, amendments, scripts, outputs, mutation outputs, results, and Lean files where a lane has them) and the owner's decision file.
